news.title: Inyo Global Enables USDC-to-Fiat Funding for Payment Prefunding
news.body: Inyo Global is enabling a USDC-to-fiat workflow for payment prefunding, targeting cash that payment providers hold ahead of payouts. The workflow connects stablecoin funding with fiat payment delivery. The reviewed coverage disclosed no quantified customer liquidity savings; eligible corridors, funding limits and redemption arrangements determine how much prefunded cash providers can release.

news.title: SEB Agrees to $33 Million NYDFS Penalty Over AML Failures
news.body: NYDFS announced October 15 that SEB and its New York branch agreed to a $33 million penalty under a consent order. The regulator identified inadequate customer and correspondent-bank due diligence, deficient client files, incorrect AML risk assessments and transaction-monitoring backlogs in Baltic subsidiaries. SEB said it would record the penalty in fourth-quarter operating expenses without changing its full-year cost target.

source.name: New York Department of Financial Services

news.title: Truist Pairs $7.7 Billion Loan Sale With Payments and Deposit Investment
news.body: Truist agreed to sell $7.7 billion of LightStream consumer loans to Carlyle, expecting approximately $7.2 billion in net proceeds and a fourth-quarter close. In October 16 earnings commentary, management outlined additional investment in mobile banking, payments, cards, rewards and treasury management as it redirects resources toward primary-account relationships. Quarterly debit and credit card spending reached $32 billion, up 4.5% year over year.

news.title: Marqeta and Coinbase Enable Stablecoin-Backed Cards for Enterprise Customers
news.body: Marqeta and Coinbase announced October 16 that Marqeta enterprise customers could offer stablecoin-backed cards. Coinbase handles custody and digital-asset conversion, while Marqeta supplies issuing, processing, and bank and network relationships. Cardholders can spend stablecoin balances through existing card acceptance without merchants accepting stablecoins directly. The announcement did not disclose commercial volumes, pricing or named enterprise adopters.

news.title: Regions Plans Real-Time Deposit Pilot Ahead of 2027 Customer Conversion
news.body: Regions said October 16 that it expected to begin piloting its cloud-based deposit platform within one to two weeks. The bank plans to expand testing in first-quarter 2027 and complete customer conversion in late second-quarter or early third-quarter 2027. Management described the platform as a real-time system that would provide capabilities unavailable on its current platform.

perspective: Inyo Global advances stablecoin prefunding as Truist redirects investment toward payments and deposits, alongside AML enforcement, stablecoin-backed cards and deposit-platform modernization.
